criteria.rationale: All quantities, cost calculations, partnership terms, and governance decisions in deliverable-1.docx match the source documents and workspace records. The deliverable appropriately applies the operative approved volume of 110,000 packs per year over five years from record-17.txt and excludes the unapproved draft volume of 150,000 packs from record-22.txt per registry.txt. All INR conversions (at USD = 83 INR) and savings calculations (INR 103,910 per pack, INR 11,430,100,000 annually, and INR 57,150,500,000 over five years) are arithmetically exact, and no unauthorized commitments or fabricated completions are made.

evidence.source_quote:
record-17.txt: revision 2; approved 2025-06-20; status in force; approved by process owner.
record-22.txt: revision 3; created 2025-06-23; status draft; not approved.
The registry, not recency alone, determines which record is operative.
evidence.output_quote: Use the approved, in-force commercial plan: 110,000 packs per year for five years, or 550,000 packs in total.

evidence.source_quote: Annual volume: 110000 packs. Program duration: 5 years.
evidence.output_quote: The newer draft proposing 150,000 packs annually is unapproved and is excluded.

evidence.source_quote: Currently the battery is 10,000 USD per battery pack (830,000 INR, at USD=83INR) inclusive of all costs. Of these costs, 1300 USD is for assembly costs, and 200 USD is for overheads. If localised for assembly only, it would need 20,000 INR for assembly costs and 590 INR for overheads
evidence.output_quote: At the approved planning volume of 110,000 packs annually over five years, the proposal reduces modelled cost from INR 830,000 to INR 726,090 per pack. Gross savings are INR 103,910 per pack, INR 11,430,100,000 annually and INR 57,150,500,000 over five years.

criteria.rationale: The deliverable provides a comprehensive, well-structured Word proposal for the CPO covering all requested elements: the 49:51 EvTronics/EV Batteries Inc. partnership structure in Delhi, the child-part sourcing model, assembly-only cost and savings calculations in INR, expected EV production volumes, benefits (regulatory progression, reduced forex exposure) and sensitivities, principal risks (imported-cell dependency, coordination complexity, unpriced capex), a four-phase localisation roadmap aligned with the PMP scenario, unresolved assumptions, and clear recommendations for gated next steps.

evidence.source_quote: Proposed Partnership structure is a 49:51::EvTronics:EV Batteries Inc. split in which EV Batteries Inc. would retain technical oversight and EvTronics leads assembly and local operations from Delhi.
evidence.output_quote: Proposed ownership is 49% EvTronics and 51% EV Batteries Inc. EvTronics would lead assembly and local operations; EV Batteries Inc. would retain technical oversight and supply imported child parts.

evidence.source_quote: Under this arrangement, EV Batteries Inc. would supply child parts— cells, housing, thermal systems, battery management system, connectors—to EvTronics, which would then assemble the battery packs locally and supply them to your plant.
evidence.output_quote: Replace the current fully assembled imported pack with child-part supply from EV Batteries Inc.: cells, housing, thermal systems, battery management system and connectors.

evidence.source_quote: Highlight the key benefits such as regulatory compliance, long-term cost reduction (reduced forex exposure), as well as the main risks including dependency on imported cells, coordination complexity, and initial capex. Include expected EV production volumes, a phased localisation timeline, and clear recommendations for next steps.
evidence.output_quote: Approve a gated feasibility and negotiation workstream. Procurement should obtain binding child-part and local-assembly quotations with landed-cost bridges and validate model-specific demand.

task_defect.reason: The request and workspace records are clear, consistent, and unambiguous.

assessment.caveat: No weighted average can offset a critical failure. Exact quotes establish traceability, not entailment. Rendering and independent human calibration remain required.
